title: No Gibberish
description: This mod removes gibberish(§k) from the game, so you can read.
body:
# What does this mod do?
It just removes gibberish, now you can see the text!
# How do I use it?
Just download the mod.
# Is that it?
Yes.
# WARNING
You will still not be able to read some texts on servers!![No Gibberish on hypixel](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b6cadae39472a2427368323dd2a6fa6bf5f608f8.png)
